note: Example screenshots for the guided-calibration wizard. Every image must be a REAL, owner-approved capture of the game with personal data removed (names, chat, private overlays). No image ships until its entry has approved:true AND a file present; until then the wizard shows an honest 'example pending' placeholder, never a fabricated picture. Annotations use fractional coordinates (0-1) over the image: {type: point|rect|label, x, y, w, h, label}.
capture_instructions: Owner: open Roblox Prospecting at the target moment (see per-item alt text), then use the Capture-example button on the wizard's calibration page (dev build, owner machine only). Crop/redact in Preview if needed, re-save over the same file, then Approve.

roblox_window.alt: The Roblox Prospecting game window on the primary display, showing the river bank with the pan HUD visible.

cap_bar.alt: The pan-fill capacity bar at the bottom of the screen; markers show the exact LEFT and RIGHT tips of the yellow bar to click.

pan_prompt.alt: The white 'Pan' prompt as it appears near the hotbar when standing at the water; a marker shows the pixel to click in the centre of the text.

deposit_prompt.alt: The white 'Collect Deposit' prompt when standing on land at a deposit; a marker shows the pixel to click.

shake_prompt.alt: The white 'Shake' prompt while holding a filled pan; a marker shows the pixel to click.

dig_green.alt: The dig meter mid-dig with its GREEN target zone visible; a marker shows a pixel inside the green zone.

money_region.alt: The money counter in the game HUD with a tight rectangle drawn around just the number.

shards_region.alt: The shards counter with a tight rectangle around the number.

find_region.alt: A find pop-up (item found toast) with a rectangle around the area where pop-ups stack.

fortune_river.alt: The Fortune River event UI with markers on the open button, home button and the scan band.

autopan_button.alt: The Auto Pan toggle button with a marker on its centre.

cue_masks.alt: A prompt close-up showing the letter-mask selection (green = kept pixels) from the guided cue capture.
